title: Koala waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tree branch -->
  <rect x='20' y='78' width='60' height='9' rx='4' fill='#8a5a33'/>
  <rect x='20' y='78' width='60' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#a87346'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='38' r='14' fill='#b7bcc4'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='38' r='14' fill='#b7bcc4'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='38' r='8' fill='#e8b9c4'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='38' r='8' fill='#e8b9c4'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='25' ry='22' fill='#cfd4dc'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='44' r='4' fill='#4a3a55'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='44' r='4' fill='#4a3a55'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='43' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='43' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='53' rx='7' ry='9' fill='#4a3a55'/>
  <ellipse cx='47.5' cy='50' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#8f7fa0'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 60 Q50 65 56 60' stroke='#6a5a78' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='20' ry='14' fill='#c3c8d1'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#e4e7ec'/>
  <!-- waving arm -->
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='66' rx='6' ry='12' fill='#c3c8d1' transform='rotate(-35 74 66)'/>
  <circle cx='81' cy='56' r='6' fill='#cfd4dc'/>
  <!-- paw pads -->
  <circle cx='79' cy='54' r='1.8' fill='#e8b9c4'/>
  <circle cx='83' cy='54' r='1.8' fill='#e8b9c4'/>
  <circle cx='81' cy='58' r='2' fill='#e8b9c4'/>
  <!-- resting arm -->
  <ellipse cx='29' cy='72' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#c3c8d1' transform='rotate(25 29 72)'/>
  <!-- feet on branch -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='82' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#b7bcc4'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='82' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#b7bcc4'/>
</svg>
